    output_grid = [[0 for _ in range(len(input_grid[0]))] for _ in range(len(input_grid))]
    non_zero_values = [(i, j, input_grid[i][j]) for i in range(len(input_grid)) for j in range(len(input_grid[0])) if input_grid[i][j] != 0]
